subject: Intro + quick fit check before demo — Storly trial signals
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@storly.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Wallis <ethan@storly.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — we just signed up

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday and I’m Samira (head of ML at Storly). We’ve been running a small self-serve PoC and are seeing promising inference quality for our support-assistant use case. Before we schedule a demo, a few quick context points so your team can tailor the session: 

- Use case: Automated triage + suggested reply generation for support tickets (multi-lingual) and a small agent that calls internal search.
- Volume: roughly 100k requests/day right now, expecting this to ramp to 400–600k/day over 3 months if performance holds.
- Concurrency: bursts up to ~120 concurrent requests during business hours.
- Tokens: average prompt+system ~600 tokens, expected to grow.
- Timeline: pilot conversion decision in ~6 weeks; hope to have a steerable demo this week or next.
- Data residency: primary users in US, but some EU data — we need clarity on residency and retention.

I attached a tiny extract of signup metrics and a sample API payload so you can see the shape. Would love a short focused demo that covers: latency characteristics for 600-token prompts, batching and caching options, and an overview of Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for our traffic profile.

Are you able to share 3 short time options in the next 10 business days? If you prefer, our Calendly link is attached in the reply.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML, Storly
Attachments: signup_metrics.csv (CSV), api_sample.txt (text)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@storly.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — we just signed up

Hi Samira — thanks for the context and the attachments, this is very helpful. I can run a tight 30–40 minute session that focuses on fit for your ticketing workflow and the performance knobs you mentioned. 

A few quick qualification items that will help us prepare the right demo setup and whom to bring from our side: 

1) SLA and security: do you need an SLA for pilot or is this an exploratory PoC? Any required compliance (SOC2, HIPAA) tied to this pilot?
2) Inference pattern: are the 100k requests/day mostly independent prompts, or do you rely heavily on streaming/long-lived sessions with KV cache reuse?
3) Priority metrics: for the pilot, do you prioritize latency tail (p95/p99) over cost per token, or is cost more important?
4) API integration: do you currently use embeddings extensively for retrieval and how large are your index sizes (approx documents)?
5) Timezone and attendees: which timezone should we consider (I’m assuming US-PST), and would you like our Solutions Engineer Monica on the call to walk the concurrency and batching parts?

Proposed slots (all 30 minutes):
- Wed Aug 4, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu Aug 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Mon Aug 9, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot on my public calendar: https://cal.com/jordan-redwood/30. I’ll loop in Monica for concurrency and runtime tuning if you confirm a time.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@storly.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T18:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — we just signed up

Looping in briefly — Ben here from Solutions. Monica and I can cover Dedicated architecture differences during the same slot if you want a deeper dive. A couple of quick notes we’ll prepare if Samira confirms a demo slot: 

- We’ll show p50/p95/p99 numbers for a 600-token prompt on a hosted profile and a dedicated pool tuned for high concurrency.
- Demo will include a short walk-through of prefix caching and KV cache reuse for session-based agents.
- I’ll prepare a conservative cost estimate for both hosted and small-dedicated pool options based on 400–600k/day.
- If Storly needs EU residency, we’ll highlight our Private deployment options and network controls.

Jordan — happy if you want us to take the technical half of the demo.

Onwards,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@storly.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Wallis <ethan@storly.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — we just signed up

Jordan and team — thanks, the proposed slots look good. We’ll take Thu Aug 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PT. Monica on the call would be ideal. Quick answers to your qualifying questions below: 

1) SLA/compliance: for pilot we don’t need a formal SLA; SOC2 is on our roadmap (not blocking right now).
2) Inference pattern: mostly independent requests from our support UI; we expect some session-level reuse for agents but not the dominant pattern yet.
3) Priority metrics: we care about p95 latency first, cost second — user experience matters more for customers.
4) API and retrieval: we use embeddings for retrieval; index is ~12M text chunks today and growing.
5) Timezone: US-PST is correct; attendees will be me, Ethan (platform), and our product manager.

Attaching the signup extract again for convenience. Let us know if you want any additional SI or engineering stakeholders on your side. We’ll expect a calendar invite shortly.

Thanks,
Samira
